Container.Name: sharedrive
Container.Overview: Sharedrive — self-hosted private file drive with user management, per-user quotas, file sharing, admin dashboard, audit logging, and Cloudflare tunnel support. Requires sharedrive-postgres and sharedrive-redis to be running first.
Container.Requires: 1. Docker network "cloudflare" must already exist (shared with your cloudflared container). 2. Docker network "sharedrive-net" must exist. Create with: docker network create sharedrive-net 3. sharedrive-postgres must be running. 4. sharedrive-redis must be running.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

Config.Name: External URL
Config.Description: Full public URL of your Sharedrive instance, e.g. https://drive.yourdomain.com — used to build share links in emails.

Config.Name: CORS Origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins. Usually the same value as External URL.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges whose proxy headers (CF-Connecting-IP, X-Forwarded-For) are trusted. Required behind Cloudflare. If your cloudflared container talks to sharedrive over a Docker network, also include that subnet (e.g. 10.10.70.0/24). The official Cloudflare IPv4 list is at https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4 — current values: 173.245.48.0/20,103.21.244.0/22,103.22.200.0/22,103.31.4.0/22,141.101.64.0/18,108.162.192.0/18,190.93.240.0/20,188.114.96.0/20,197.234.240.0/22,198.41.128.0/17,162.158.0.0/15,104.16.0.0/13,104.24.0.0/14,172.64.0.0/13,131.0.72.0/22. Leave blank if not behind a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Cookie Domain
Config.Description: Explicit cookie domain scope. Leave blank for host-only cookies (most secure default). Only needed if session cookies must be shared across subdomains. Note: the direct-upload subdomain does NOT require this — it uses X-Upload-Token headers instead of cookies.

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL container. Must match the container name of sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port. Leave as 5432 unless you changed it.

Config.Name: Postgres Database
Config.Description: PostgreSQL database name. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres User
Config.Description: PostgreSQL user. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL password. Must match the value set in sharedrive-postgres.

Config.Name: Redis Address
Config.Description: Address of the Redis container in host:port format. Must match the container name of sharedrive-redis.

Config.Name: Session Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for signing session tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Backup HMAC Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for HMAC-signing backup exports. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Backup Wrap Key
Config.Description: AES-256-GCM key used to encrypt your backup token at rest so the server can run automatic scheduled backups without user interaction. Required for the Automatic Backup feature. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: TOTP Encrypt Key
Config.Description: AES-256-GCM key for encrypting TOTP secrets at rest. Must be exactly 32 bytes — generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Device Trust Secret
Config.Description: Secret key for HMAC-signing device-trust tokens. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: SMTP Host
Config.Description: Hostname of your SMTP server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com — required for share invites and password-reset emails.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP port. 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for TLS/SSL, 25 for plain.

Config.Name: SMTP Username
Config.Description: SMTP login username / email address.

Config.Name: SMTP Password
Config.Description: SMTP login password or app-specific password.

Config.Name: SMTP From Address
Config.Description: The From: address used in outgoing emails, e.g. sharedrive@yourdomain.com

Config.Name: SMTP TLS Mode
Config.Description: TLS mode: starttls (port 587), tls (port 465), or none (port 25).

Config.Name: WebDAV Enabled
Config.Description: Enable WebDAV access for mounting the drive as a network drive.

Config.Name: Require TOTP for Admins
Config.Description: Require admin accounts to have TOTP two-factor authentication enabled.

Config.Name: Files Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where uploaded files are stored. Ensure this directory exists and has sufficient free space.

Config.Name: Backups Storage
Config.Description: Path on the host where backup archives are stored (default internal path).

Config.Name: External Backup Disk (optional)
Config.Description: Optional: mount an external disk or NAS share for server-side backup storage. Leave blank if not using this feature. Set BACKUPS_ROOT to /mnt/backup to enable it.

Config.Name: BACKUPS_ROOT
Config.Description: Set to the container path of your external backup disk (e.g. /mnt/backup) to enable server-side backup storage. Leave blank to use the default /data/backups path (no extra mount needed).
